subject: Animation
title: Kizazi Moto: Afrofuturism in Animation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Kizazi Moto: Afrofuturism in Animation.

hook.text: Disney released Kizazi Moto: Generation Fire in 2023, an anthology of animated shorts from African creators.

buildup.text: Each short was created by a different African animation studio, showcasing the continent's diverse visual styles.

discovery.text: The anthology explored Afrofuturism — blending African traditions with science fiction and fantasy themes.

twist.text: Disney funded the project but gave African creators unusual creative freedom to tell their own stories.

climax.text: Kizazi Moto proved that African animators could produce world-class work given the right platform and funding.

punchline.text: African storytellers used Disney's platform to show the world their future.

quiz.question: What was the significance of Kizazi Moto for African animation?
options: It was Disney's first animated feature set in Africa
It showcased diverse African animation studios and proved they could produce world-class Afrofuturist work
It was the first animated show dubbed in African languages
